title: 6G & Smart City IoT Framework — Academic Publication
description: Peer-Reviewed Research published under Springer Nature addressing the 6G-Enabled Smart Cities paradigm, focusing on bandwidth and AI integration in home automation frameworks.

body.raw:
## Publication

**Springer Nature Link** · Conference Proceedings, pp. 137–150

## Abstract

This peer-reviewed conference paper addresses the "6G-Enabled Smart Cities" paradigm, exploring how ultra-high-bandwidth 6G connectivity combined with AI-driven home automation can unlock the next generation of intelligent urban infrastructure.

## Key Contributions

- Published as a **peer-reviewed conference paper (pp. 137–150)**, demonstrating rigorous academic validation and expert review.
- Conducted in-depth analysis on the **evolution of IoT connectivity** from 4G/5G to 6G, contributing to cyber-physical systems research.
- Proposed an architectural framework integrating **embedded systems and AI inference** at the edge for real-time smart home control.

## Tools & Domains

Internet Computing · IoT · 6G Networking · Embedded Systems · AI · Smart Cities
